sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium washingtonianum, plant_name_id 280210.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.9-1.5 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 2 m'. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 1.2 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.9-1.5 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 2 m'.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems to 2 m, often glaucous

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves in 1-8 whorls or partial whorls

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): in 1-8 whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): 3-16 leaves per whorl. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 3.7-12.3 x 0.9-4.7 cm

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 0.9-4.7 cm wide, 2-6.5 times longer than wide. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade oblanceolate, sometimes obovate, rarely elliptic

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): horizontal and drooping at tips to ascending

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences racemose, 1-33-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers more or less horizontal, slightly bilaterally symmetric, strongly fragrant

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth more or less funnelform

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals and petals recurved 2/3-3/4 along length from base and scarcely overlapping to form tube

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): recurved 2/3-3/4 along length from base

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): petals noticeably wider than sepals, oblanceolate and often very wide distally

traits.petal_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): petal apex widely acute, obtuse, or rounded

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): white, often aging deep pink or lavender The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): often with fine magenta spots concentrated basally

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): magenta spots The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals (6.1-)6.7-11.3 cm, petals (6.1-)6.6-11.2 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens barely exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers off white or cream, becoming pale pink or yellow The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 4.8-15 cm

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 2.7-5.8 x 1.6-2.9 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1.6-2.9 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium washingtonianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): subsp. purpurascens flowering summer (mid Jun-mid Aug)
